units: Erub. 56ᵃ והוא דאתיליד ל׳ או בל׳ וכ׳ provided the new moon sets in either at the moon-hour (the second hour of the night of the first day of the week and every eighth hour suceeding) or under the planet Tsedek (Jupiter).
